# components/hero

<!-- GENERATED by scripts/build-docs.ts from components/hero/hero.ts — edit the source, then `deno task docs`. -->

Import: `import { Hero } from "@tundralibs/ui/hero"`

Shown on its demo page (`deno task build:demos`, then `demo/components/hero.html`). Guides: [Getting started](../UI-Getting-Started.md) · [rAPId integration](../UI-Rapid.md) · [Theming](../UI-Theming.md).

## Functions

### `Hero`

```ts
Hero(props: HeroProps): Html
```

The opening band of a landing page. Full-bleed friendly: put it in a
`StackedLayout({ width: "bleed" })` and its own `.container` keeps the
text on the page's column. The title balances its lines; the vertical
padding is `--hero-padding-block`, a theme's to retune.

## Types

### `HeroAlign`

Where the text sits: the start edge, or centred.

- `"start"`
- `"center"`

### `HeroLayout`

Stacked puts the media under the text; split puts it beside, from 992px.

- `"stacked"`
- `"split"`

### `HeroSize`

The title's scale.

- `"md"`
- `"lg"`

### `HeroTone`

The ground: the page's, the inverse surface, or a soft accent wash.

- `"default"`
- `"inverse"`
- `"accent"`

### `HeroProps`

| Prop | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `eyebrow` | `string | Html` |  | A short line above the title — a product name, a launch tag. |
| `title` | `string | Html` | yes |  |
| `text` | `string | Html` |  |  |
| `actions` | `Html` |  | Buttons, usually a primary and an outline one. |
| `media` | `Html` |  | An `<img>`, a `<video>`, an illustration — anything that fills a box. |
| `align` | `HeroAlign` |  |  |
| `layout` | `HeroLayout` |  |  |
| `size` | `HeroSize` |  |  |
| `tone` | `HeroTone` |  |  |
| `parallax` | `boolean` |  | The media drifts against the scroll (see `Parallax`); still under reduced motion and on phones. |
| `fill` | `boolean` |  | Fill the first screen: at least the small viewport's height (`svh`, so a phone's collapsing toolbar never pushes the bottom off) minus `--hero-fill-offset` (default `--scroll-padding-top`, the sticky header's height), the text centred in the room. With a `footer`, hero and footer together are exactly that first screen. |
| `footer` | `Html` |  | A strip at the hero's foot — a facts row, logos — inside the band, so `fill` counts it. |
| `attrs` | `Attrs` |  |  |

## Usage

Each example as the rAPId call and the HTML it renders — the markup a plain page writes by hand. Icons are inline SVG in the real output; they are shortened to `<svg …>…</svg>` here.

### A landing page's opening band

Put it in `StackedLayout({ width: "bleed" })`; its own `.container` keeps the text on the page column.

```ts
Hero({
  eyebrow: "Invoicing for small teams",
  title: "Get paid on time, every time.",
  text: "Send invoices your customers can pay in one click, and let the reminders chase the late ones.",
  actions: html`
    ${Button({ label: "Start free", size: "lg", href: "/signup" })}${Button({
      label: "See a demo",
      size: "lg",
      variant: "outline",
      href: "/demo",
    })}
  `,
  media: html`
    <img src="/img/app.png" width="960" height="640" alt="The invoices screen" loading="eager">
  `,
  layout: "split",
  parallax: true,
})
```

```html
<section class="hero hero--split">
  <div class="container hero__inner">
    <div class="hero__body">
      <p class="hero__eyebrow">Invoicing for small teams</p>
      <h1 class="hero__title">Get paid on time, every time.</h1>
      <p class="hero__text">Send invoices your customers can pay in one click, and let the reminders chase the late ones.</p>
      <div class="hero__actions">
        <a class="btn btn--lg" href="/signup">Start free</a>
        <a class="btn btn--outline btn--lg" href="/demo">See a demo</a>
      </div>
    </div>
    <div class="hero__media parallax" data-parallax="0.15">
      <img src="/img/app.png" width="960" height="640" alt="The invoices screen" loading="eager">
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

### A centred statement on the inverse ground

```ts
Hero({
  title: "One place for every invoice",
  text: "A calmer month end.",
  align: "center",
  tone: "inverse",
  size: "md",
})
```

```html
<section class="hero hero--center hero--md hero--inverse">
  <div class="container hero__inner">
    <div class="hero__body">
      <h1 class="hero__title">One place for every invoice</h1>
      <p class="hero__text">A calmer month end.</p>
    </div>
  </div>
</section>
```

### The first screen, with a facts strip

`fill` makes the band at least `100svh` minus `--hero-fill-offset` (the sticky header, `--scroll-padding-top` by default); the `footer` sits inside it, so hero and facts are exactly the first screen.

```ts
Hero({
  title: "Short links your customers trust",
  text: "Branded domains, live analytics and a team plan that grows with you.",
  align: "center",
  fill: true,
  actions: Button({ label: "Start free", size: "lg", href: "/signup" }),
  footer: html`
    <ul class="cluster" aria-label="Facts">
      <li>99.99% uptime</li>
      <li>2B redirects a month</li>
    </ul>
  `,
})
```

```html
<section class="hero hero--center hero--fill">
  <div class="container hero__inner">
    <div class="hero__body">
      <h1 class="hero__title">Short links your customers trust</h1>
      <p class="hero__text">Branded domains, live analytics and a team plan that grows with you.</p>
      <div class="hero__actions">
        <a class="btn btn--lg" href="/signup">Start free</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
  <div class="container hero__footer">
    <ul class="cluster" aria-label="Facts">
      <li>99.99% uptime</li>
      <li>2B redirects a month</li>
    </ul>
  </div>
</section>
```
